topic: Scheduling the Job Interview by Phone

script.title: BOOKING THE INTERVIEW
script.story_hook: One quick phone call sets up the whole interview.
script.intro_zh: 一通簡短的電話，就能把面試安排好。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's office phone call. Listen for booking phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的辦公室致電場景。留意預約面試的說法。
script.outro: And that's an interview booked for Thursday. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一場週四的面試就這樣約好了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Save the suit for the boss
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with short grey-streaked hair, thin wire-frame glasses, a navy blazer over a light blue shirt, a worn leather folder, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a calm middle-aged woman in her fifties with shoulder-length straight auburn hair, small reading glasses, a cream cardigan over a burgundy blouse, and a soft rounded build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, good morning, I'm calling about the open job.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪm ˈkɔlɪŋ əˈbaʊt ði ˈoʊpən dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，早上好，我是為了那個職缺打電話來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I can help you set up an interview.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ aɪ kən hɛlp ju sɛt ʌp æn ˈɪntɚvju/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我可以幫你安排一場面試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ aɪ ˈɹɪli əˈpɹiʃiˌeɪt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真的太感謝了，我很感激。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you have the reference number handy?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə ˈɹɛfɚəns ˈnʌmbɚ ˈhændi/
dialogue.zh: 你手邊有求職編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, it's B fourteen, from the listing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ɪts bi ˌfɔrˈtin fɹʌm ðə ˈlɪstɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，是 B14，從職缺廣告上看到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, and how should I spell your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd haʊ ʃʊd aɪ spɛl jɔɹ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好的，請問你的名字該怎麼拼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cole, C O L E, just four letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊl si ˈoʊ ɛl ˈi dʒʌst fɔɹ ˈlɛɾɚz/
dialogue.zh: Cole，C-O-L-E，就四個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice and easy. When can you come in?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈæn ˈizi wɛn kən ju kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好記又簡單。你什麼時候方便來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, almost any morning next week works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈɛni ˈmɔɹnɪŋ nɛkst wik wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，下週幾乎任何一個上午都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, how about Tuesday at ten sharp?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈtuzdeɪ ɛt tɛn ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，那週二上午十點整如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, Tuesday's rough, I have a dentist trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ ˈtuzdeɪz ɹʌf aɪ hæv ə ˈdɛntɪst tɹɪp/
dialogue.zh: 噢，週二不太方便，我得去牙醫那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, Thursday ten thirty then?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ˈθɝzdeɪ tɛn ˈθɜɹdi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，那週四十點半呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday works, if that's okay for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ wɝks ɪf ðæts ˌoʊˈkeɪ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 週四沒問題，如果你也方便的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for me. You'll be on floor three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt fɚ mi jul bi ɑn flɔɹ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊剛好。你的面試在三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Floor three, got it. What's the exact address?
dialogue.phonetic: /flɔɹ θɹi ɡɑɾ ɪt wæts ði ɪɡˈzækt əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 三樓，記下了。詳細地址是哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine oh four Maple Street, the blue brick building.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈoʊ ˈfɔɹ ˈmeɪpəl stɹit ðə blu bɹɪk ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 楓樹街904號，那棟藍色磚造大樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and do I ring a bell at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ænd du aɪ ɹɪŋ ə bɛl ɛt ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好，進門的時候需要按鈴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, just walk up to the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈæt ˈɔl dʒʌst wɔk ʌp tə ðə fɹʌnt dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 不用，直接走到最前面的櫃檯就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What name should I ask for?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈneɪm ʃʊd aɪ æsk fɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請問我要找誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, just ask for Dana at reception.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst æsk fɚ ˈdanə ɛt ɹɪˈsɛpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 不用，到接待處找 Dana 就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dana, noted. How long will the interview run?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdanə ˈnoʊtɪd haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ði ˈɪntɚvju ɹʌn/
dialogue.zh: Dana，記住了。面試大約會進行多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around thirty minutes, maybe a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɹaʊnd ˈθɜɹdi ˈmɪnəts ˈmeɪbi ə bɪt mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 大概三十分鐘，也許再久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a copy of anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ ə ˈkɑpi ʌv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要帶什麼影印資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please bring a photo ID and your resume.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz bɹɪŋ ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌaɪ ˈdi ænd jɔɹ ˈrɛzʊˌmeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 要的，請帶附照片的身分證和履歷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, do I need the whole resume printed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm du aɪ nid ði hoʊl ˈrɛzʊˌmeɪ ˈpɹɪntɪd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，履歷要整份列印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two copies, one for you and one for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu ˈkɑpiz wʌn fɚ ju ænd wʌn fɚ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 兩份就好，你一份，我們一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And can I bring a folder to keep them flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ ə ˈfoʊldɚ tə kip ðəm flæt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶個資料夾，讓紙張保持平整嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, totally fine, folders make you look prepared.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtoʊtəli faɪn ˈfoʊldɚz meɪk ju lʊk pɹɪˈpɪrd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，當然可以，資料夾讓你看起來很周全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I like to look prepared.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ laɪk tə lʊk pɹɪˈpɪrd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我喜歡看起來有準備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Parking is the one tricky part here.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈpɑɹkɪŋ ɪz ðə wʌn ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。這裡只有停車比較讓人頭疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, is the street metered all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ ɪz ðə stɹit ˈmitɚɹd ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，路邊停車整天都要計費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, and it fills up fast by nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ænd ɪt fɪlz ʌp fæst baɪ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，一到九點位子就滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So should I plan to arrive early?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd aɪ plæn tə əˈɹaɪv ˈɝli/
dialogue.zh: 那我該提早一點出門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd say ten minutes early, not much sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd seɪ tɛn ˈmɪnəts ˈɝli nɑt mʌtʃ ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 建議早十分鐘到就好，別太早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a lot nearby instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛɹ ə lɑt ˈnɪɹˌbaɪ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 附近有沒有收費停車場？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a paid lot behind the coffee shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə peɪd lɑt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkɔfi ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡店後面就有一個付費停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does that lot cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðæt lɑt kɑst/
dialogue.zh: 那個停車場要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars an hour, and it's covered.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdɑləɹz ən ˈaʊɚ ænd ɪts ˈkʌvɚd/
dialogue.zh: 一小時兩塊，還有遮雨棚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and what about the morning commute?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ænd wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ kəˈmjut/
dialogue.zh: 好，那早上的交通要怎麼安排？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buses stop right outside, the twelve and forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌsəz stɑp ɹaɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə twɛlv ænd ˈfɔɹti/
dialogue.zh: 公車就停在門口，12路跟40路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I might skip the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ maɪt skɪp ðə kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 知道就好，我可能不開車過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either way, give us a call if you're late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːðɚ weɪ ɡɪv ʌs ə kɔl ɪf jʊɹ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 總之要是遲到，請打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Definitely. Is there a phone number for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛfənətli ɪz ðɛɹ ə foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 一定。有專門聯絡的電話號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll text it after we hang up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl tɛkst ɪt ˈæftɚ wi hæŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好，掛了電話我就把號碼傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, my battery's about to die, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl maɪ ˈbæɾəriz əˈbaʊt tə daɪ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，老實說我的電池快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, then I'll be quick. Anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ ðɛn aɪl bi kwɪk ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那我長話短說。還有別的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one thing, is the dress code strict?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn θɪŋ ɪz ðə dɹɛs koʊd stɹɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 就一件事，穿著規定嚴格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nah, business casual is totally fine here.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑ ˈbɪznəz ˈkæʒuəl ɪz ˈtoʊtəli faɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，商務休閒樣式就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So jeans and a shirt would work?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dʒinz ænd ə ʃɝt wʊd wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 那牛仔褲加襯衫就可以了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean dark jeans, sure, and a nice top.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin dɑɹk dʒinz ʃʊɹ ænd ə naɪs tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的深色牛仔褲，再加一件體面的上衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief, I was picturing a stiff suit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlif aɪ wəz pɪkˈtʃɚɪŋ ə stɪf sut/
dialogue.zh: 鬆口氣，我還以為要穿僵硬的正裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, save the suit for the boss.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪv ðə sut fɚ ðə bɑs/
dialogue.zh: 哈，正裝留給未來的老闆吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, boss gets the suit someday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd bɑs ɡɛts ðə sut ˈsʌmˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，等有老闆那天再穿正裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, Thursday ten thirty, Dana, floor three.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈθɝzdeɪ tɛn ˈθɜɹdi ˈdanə flɔɹ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 好，週四十點半，找 Dana，在三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me read it back to make sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɹid ɪt bæk tə meɪk ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 讓我覆誦一遍確認一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, catch me if I'm wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du kætʃ mi ɪf aɹm ɹɑŋ/
dialogue.zh: 請說，我要是講錯就提醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, ten thirty, nine oh four Maple, floor three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ tɛn ˈθɜɹdi naɪn ˈoʊ ˈfɔɹ ˈmeɪpəl flɔɹ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 週四，十點半，楓樹街904號，三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You nailed it. I'll email you the confirmation.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju neɪld ɪt aɪl ˈimeɪl ju ðə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確。我會用郵件發確認函給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, thanks for your patience today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt θæŋks fɔɹ jɔɹ ˈpeɪʃəns təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今天真是謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, Cole, see you Thursday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒɚ koʊl si ju ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，Cole，週四早上見。

script.youtube_title: 【約面試打這通電話☎️】「正裝留給未來的老闆」👔教你用英文預約工作面試🗓️｜聽完就能自己約｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Job Interview Scheduling
script.youtube_title_en: "Save the Suit for the Boss" — Scheduling a Job Interview by Phone
script.youtube_description:
「正裝留給未來的老闆」——一通電話怎麼用英文把面試約好、地址問清、停車搞定？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在求職者撥給公司辦公室的那通預約電話。

你會聽到：開場說明來意、報上求職編號與名字拼法、換掉衝突的日子、確認時間與樓層地址；還有要帶幾份履歷、身分證怎麼準備，以及路邊計費、付費停車場、公車站牌等停車細節，最後逐項覆誦確認。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人講電話的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、nope、okay。聽完你就會用：I'm calling about...、How about...、What's the exact address?、I'll email you the confirmation。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Save the suit for the boss" — how do you book a job interview in English over one phone call? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around the call a job seeker makes to the office.

You will hear: stating why you are calling, giving the reference number and spelling your name, swapping a clashing day, and locking in the time, floor and exact address; plus how many resume copies to bring, what ID to prepare, and the whole parking situation with meters, a paid lot and bus lines, ending with a line-by-line read-back.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the real phone texture Americans use: um, well, so, ha, nope, okay. By the end you'll own phrases like I'm calling about..., How about..., What's the exact address?, and I'll email you the confirmation.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧電話預約面試英文・確認樓層地址・停車收費細節｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
好不容易接到面試通知，一通電話該怎麼用英文把時間、地址、停車一次問清楚？要帶幾份履歷、身分證怎麼準備，才不會白跑一趟？

這一集帶大家陪求職者撥給公司辦公室，從報上編號、挑選日子、確認樓層與地址，一路聽到停車對策與最後的逐項覆誦，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
☎️ 開場句：Hi, good morning, I'm calling about the open job.
🗓️ 換日子：Oh, Tuesday's rough, I have a dentist trip.
🅿️ 停車句：There's a paid lot behind the coffee shop.
✅ 覆誦確認：Thursday, ten thirty, nine oh four Maple, floor three.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、nope 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這通預約電話走一遍，下次自己打電話約面試，話就從嘴邊自然冒出來。

祝你下一通面試電話都順利約好。
